name: app-suite
description: Skills for finding, vetting and shipping mobile apps: App Store and Google Play keyword research from free public data, go / no-go vetting of app ideas with a cost analysis, and a pre-submission store review.

research_dir.title: Research folder
research_dir.description: Where research reports are saved, one folder per topic. Leave empty to save under research/ in the project you're working in.

ideas_dir.title: Ideas folder
ideas_dir.description: Where idea files are kept, one per idea. Leave empty to use ideas/ in the project you're working in.

stack.title: Build stack
stack.description: What you build apps with, for judging whether an idea fits. Leave empty for Expo, Firebase, RevenueCat and EAS Hosting.

reviews_dir.title: Reviews folder
reviews_dir.description: Where store reviews are saved, one dated folder per review. Leave empty to use store-review/ in the app's project folder.
